specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Extended Buff Range
specialRules.description: If this unit is within 24" of another friendly unit with this rule that has a Hero in it, then that Hero may use special rules that allow it to pick friendly units within 12" (except for spells) on this unit as if it was in range.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Shadowborn
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Shadowborn, enemy units shooting/charging it get -8"/-4" range to a min. of 6" from Shadowborn (instead of only -4"/-2").

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Shadowborn Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Enhanced Shadowborn once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Shadowborn
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".

specialRules.name: Ravage
specialRules.description: Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Regeneration Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Bounding
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

specialRules.name: Precision Target
specialRules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when attacking them.

specialRules.name: Dodge
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they aren't Fatigued, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls in melee against them.

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +6" range on its weapons when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Thrust in Melee Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Thrust in Melee once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer
specialRules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher.

specialRules.name: Demolish
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and when attacking units with most models within 1" of terrain, this weapon gets AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Anti-Regen
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

specialRules.name: Counter in Melee Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Counter in Melee.

specialRules.name: Anti-Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Rapid Rush Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Rapid Rush once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Shadowborn Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Enhanced Shadowborn.

specialRules.name: Spell Resistance
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unpredictable Fighter against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Shrouded
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Shrouded, enemy units shooting/charging it get -8"/-4" range to a min. of 6" from Shrouded (instead of only -4"/-2").

specialRules.name: Shrouded
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Hero
specialRules.description: Heroes with up to Tough(6) may deploy as part of one multi-model unit without another Hero, but must use the unit’s Defense until all other models have been killed. The Hero’s unit, and units within 6” of friendly Heroes with Tough(9) or higher, may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: AP

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Thrust
specialRules.description: When charging, gets +1 to hit rolls and AP(+1) in melee.

specialRules.name: Thrust in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Thrust on its weapons in melee.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: This model must take X wounds before being killed. If a model with Tough joins a unit without it, then it is removed last when the unit takes wounds. You must continue to put wounds on the Tough model with most wounds in the unit until it is killed, before starting to put them on the next Tough model (Heroes must be assigned wounds last, even if already wounded).

specialRules.name: Counter in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Counter on its weapons in melee.

specialRules.name: Counter
specialRules.description: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.

specialRules.name: Rapid Rush
specialRules.description: This model moves +6" when using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable
specialRules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

forceOrgErrors: May not bring any single unit worth more than 35% of total points (350pts).
